hygiene.careTitle: What to keep in mind while it heals
care: Wash your hands thoroughly before you touch the tattoo.
Remove the film after the first few hours, clean the area with lukewarm water and mild soap and pat it dry.
Apply a thin layer of healing ointment.
Avoid direct sunlight, sunbeds and swimming in pools or lakes until the skin has healed.
If you notice strong redness, swelling or pus, please see a doctor straight away.

healing.title: What does hygiene mean after the appointment?
healing.intro: Clean hands and a clean wound. A fresh tattoo is a wound that you look after yourself at home.
items: Wash your hands thoroughly before you touch the tattoo.
Clean the area gently with lukewarm water and a mild soap and pat it dry.
Apply a thin layer of healing ointment.
Wear loose clothing that does not rub on the tattoo, and do not sleep on the fresh area.
Avoid direct sunlight, sunbeds and swimming in pools or lakes until the skin has healed.
healing.warning: If you notice signs of infection such as strong redness, swelling or discharge of pus, please see a doctor straight away.

aftercare.lead: The right care is key to healing and to how your tattoo looks in the long run. Here is what to do in the first hours, while it heals and afterwards.
aftercare.imageAlt: Patrick Wolf laughing at his workstation in the studio, wearing black gloves

phases.title: How do you care for your tattoo, step by step?
phases.intro: In three phases, one after the other. In every phase: wash your hands thoroughly before you touch the tattoo.

items.title: The first hours
points: Take the film off after the first few hours.
Clean the area gently with lukewarm water and a mild soap.
Pat it dry and apply a thin layer of a recommended healing ointment.

items.title: While it heals
points: Clean the tattoo regularly and care for it with a tattoo aftercare cream.
Do not scratch.
Avoid direct sunlight, sunbeds and swimming in pools or lakes. All of these can affect how the wound heals.
Wear loose clothing that does not rub on the tattoo.
Do not sleep on the freshly tattooed area.

items.title: After healing
points: Keep caring for your tattoo regularly with a fragrance free moisturiser.
Protect it from strong sun with a high sun protection factor. This keeps the colours and the look intact.

warning.title: When should you see a doctor?
warning.text: Straight away if you notice signs of infection: strong redness, swelling or discharge of pus.

Such links are plain references: data only goes to the provider once you click the link. From then on the privacy policy of that provider applies.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.intro: Towards {operator} you have, at any time, the right of
items: access to the data stored about you (Art. 15 GDPR),
withdrawal of consent you have given, with effect for the future (Art. 7(3) GDPR).
rights.request: An email to this address is enough for any request:
rights.objection: Where we process data on the basis of Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, you may object at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation (Art. 21 GDPR). We then no longer process the data unless there are compelling legitimate grounds for the processing or it serves the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims.

complaint.title: Complaint to a supervisory authority
complaint.text: You have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR), in particular in the member state of your habitual residence, your place of work or the place of the alleged infringement. The authority competent for {operator}, based in Hesse, is the Hessian Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information:

duty.title: Obligation to provide data and automated decisions
duty.text: You are not obliged to provide us with data. Without contact details, however, we cannot handle a request or an appointment. There is no automated decision making, including profiling.

booking.question: How do I book an appointment at KurstadtTattoo?
booking.answer: We take appointment requests by phone at {phone}. For other questions you can email us at {email}.

ownDesign.question: Can I bring my own design?
ownDesign.answer: Yes. You can bring your own design, and we turn it into a tattoo that matches your wishes. Photos and memories, for a portrait for example, are a good starting point too.

finishing.question: Do you finish tattoos that were started somewhere else?
finishing.answer: Yes, we do. Bring the unfinished tattoo to your consultation and we will talk about how to complete it.

care.question: How do I look after my new tattoo?
care.answer: Clean the tattoo regularly and apply a thin layer of healing ointment. Wash your hands thoroughly first, avoid direct sunlight and do not scratch.

removal.question: Can I have a tattoo removed?
removal.answer: Tattoos are removed by laser and fade gradually, usually over several sessions. Dermatologists offer this treatment. We are happy to give you information about it.

reopening.question: When does the new studio open?
reopening.answer: On 1 December 2026 at Friedrich-Ebert-Platz 1A, 61231 Bad Nauheim. Until then the studio is closed.

styles.question: Which styles does KurstadtTattoo tattoo?
styles.answer: The focus is on realistic portraits and fine lines. We also tattoo colour pieces, black and grey, blackwork, tribal, lettering and ornamental work. The gallery shows examples of each style.

artist.question: Who tattoos at KurstadtTattoo?
artist.answer: Patrick Wolf runs the studio and is the specialist in realistic portraits and fine lines.

fainting.question: Has anyone ever fainted while getting tattooed?
fainting.answer: Yes, it has happened. Patrick talks about it in a short video on YouTube.

aftercare.question: Is there aftercare after the appointment?
aftercare.answer: Yes. We offer aftercare and are there for you if you have questions or problems while your tattoo heals.

hours.question: When is KurstadtTattoo open?
hours.answer: Until now Monday to Friday from 12 noon to 6 pm or by appointment. Please call {phone} to ask about the hours at the new location.

steps.title: Call and request an appointment
steps.text: We take appointment requests by phone. Tell us briefly which design you have in mind and where it should go.

steps.title: Planning the design together
steps.text: We plan your tattoo closely with you until it matches what you have in mind. Feel free to bring your own design, photos or ideas.

steps.title: Your session in the studio
steps.text: The agreed design is tattooed with care and an eye for detail, in a pleasant and safe atmosphere.

steps.title: Care and aftercare
steps.text: You get instructions on how to care for the tattoo while it heals. If you have questions, we are there for you and offer aftercare.

consent.noticeTitle: May the cal.com booking calendar load?
consent.noticeBooking: This website sets no cookies for analytics or advertising. For online booking we embed the calendar of cal.com (Cal.com, Inc., USA). When it loads, your browser sends your IP address, among other data, to cal.com in the USA, and cal.com sets a cookie to fend off automated access. This only happens with your consent.
consent.noticeBookingAnalytics: For online booking we embed the calendar of cal.com (Cal.com, Inc., USA). With Google Analytics by Google Ireland Limited we evaluate how our pages are used. Both services receive your IP address, among other data, set cookies and may transfer data to the USA. This only happens with your consent, and you can choose each service separately.
consent.noticeRest: Without consent the website works fully, and you request your appointment by phone. You can change or withdraw your choice at any time under Cookie settings at the bottom of every page.
consent.necessaryText: Stores your choice in this browser (localStorage, entry kt-consent with the version of the notice, the time and your selection), so we do not ask again. No identifier, read only by this website. No consent needed, § 25(2) no. 2 TDDDG.
consent.bookingText: Loads the booking calendar of Cal.com, Inc., San Francisco, USA, on the Book appointment page once it comes into view. cal.com then receives your IP address, browser and device details and the address of the page. Its service provider Cloudflare sets the cookie __cf_bm against automated access (30 minutes), and technical error reports go to Sentry. Transfer to the USA on the basis of the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, § 25(1) TDDDG), which you can withdraw here at any time. Without it the calendar stays off, and you request appointments by phone.
consent.analyticsText: Loads Google Analytics 4 by Google Ireland Limited, Dublin, Ireland, and evaluates which pages are used and how. Google then receives your IP address, browser and device details and the pages you visit, and sets the cookies _ga and _ga_ with the website's ID (up to 2 years). A transfer to the USA is possible, on the basis of the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, § 25(1) TDDDG), which you can withdraw here at any time. Without it Google Analytics is not loaded and nothing is sent to Google.

privacyBooking.title: Online booking via cal.com
privacyBooking.intro: For online booking we embed a calendar of the service cal.com. The provider is Cal.com, Inc., 2261 Market Street #4382, San Francisco, CA 94114, USA.
privacyBooking.when: The calendar is on the Book appointment page. It only loads if you have consented, in the privacy notice, in the cookie settings or with the button Agree and load calendar in the booking area. Even then it does not load with the page, but only once the booking area comes into view. From that moment your browser fetches content from cal.com servers. Nothing from cal.com is loaded on any other page.
privacyBooking.data: As soon as the calendar loads, cal.com receives technical data: your IP address, browser and device details, the address of the page the calendar is embedded in, and the date and time. Cloudflare, a service provider used by cal.com, sets the cookie __cf_bm, which fends off automated access (bots) and expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. The calendar also sends technical error reports to Sentry, which cal.com uses for error analysis.
privacyBooking.booking: When you book an appointment, cal.com also processes what you enter in the booking form, in particular your name, email address, the chosen time and your message. cal.com sends the booking confirmation by email.
privacyBooking.recipientDemo: At the moment a demo calendar for the preview is embedded on this website. It sits in the cal.com account of the web developer of this website, {holder}, not in an account of KurstadtTattoo. Booking details therefore go to that account and not to us, and no appointment at KurstadtTattoo is made through it. For a real appointment please call or send an email. This notice will be removed once the studio's calendar is embedded.
privacyBooking.recipientLive: We receive this information in order to hold the appointment with you.
privacyBooking.basis: Loading the calendar and the related transfer to cal.com are based on your consent (Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR). Where information is stored on or read from your device in the process, such as the cookie __cf_bm, the legal basis is also your consent (§ 25(1) TDDDG). Processing your details when you book serves to take steps at your request prior to entering into a contract (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR).
privacyBooking.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time with effect for the future, in the cookie settings. After that the calendar no longer loads. Cookies that cal.com has set on its own domain expire (__cf_bm after 30 minutes of inactivity) or can be deleted in your browser.
privacyBooking.transfer: cal.com processes the data in the USA. Cal.com, Inc. is certified under the EU-U.S. Data Privacy Framework (checked on 12 November 2026); the transfer is therefore based on the adequacy decision of the European Commission under Art. 45 GDPR. For transfers outside this framework cal.com uses the standard contractual clauses of the European Commission.
privacyBooking.retentionDemo: We do not receive booking data from the demo calendar. It is held in the cal.com account of {holder} and stored and deleted under the rules of cal.com.
privacyBooking.retentionLive: We delete booking data once it is no longer needed to hold and follow up on the appointment, unless statutory retention duties apply.
privacyBooking.alternative: If you do not consent or do not want to use cal.com, simply request your appointment by phone.
